detail.name: Alice's Namecard
detail.desc: Get by unlocking Alice's Mindscape: Symmetrism
detail.desc2:
A name card bearing the image of the heiress of the Thymefield family.
Many high-society figures have tried to get their hands on this noble family's contact info, only to end up with a "business card" that's all symmetry and no number. But this one's special... it has the young lady's name written in graceful script, plus a cute, perfectly symmetrical doodle of a bunny — showing just how much she values the person receiving it.
